parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: Flask.run() splits SERVER_NAME with partition(":") at the first colon, so an IPv6 literal like [::1]:port yields host "[" and a bogus port that makes int() raise ValueError. Description A adds detail about the explicit-port case and bracketed addresses without a port, and Description B adds a regression framing versus urlsplit, but the root cause and location are the same.
